summary: `anvil search` and MCP `search` run graph query -> docs search -> code grep fallback in one budget; PreToolUse answers the first code search of a turn (Grep/Glob tools, MCP grep, shell rg/grep/findstr/Select-String/anvil grep) with the graph+docs results when neither was consulted yet; search.cascade = enforce|advise|off; MCP instructions and templates describe the order.
